description: An agent that does not advertise the extension gets no projection.

input.scenario: The ACP agent's initialize response has no agentCapabilities._meta["io.github.fullfran.hcs"]; the generation has entries for that engine.

expect.behaviour: The host sends no session/new from the generation to it and reports unsupported_contribution for each of those entries; per R017 this does not fail the generation on other engines.
